english.note: A speaker uses this vulgar colloquial noun for a buttock or butt cheek, especially when the body is exposed.

examples.english: The swim trunks were too small, so half my butt cheek was exposed.
examples.traditional: 游水嗰陣，條泳褲太細，露咗半邊屎忽。
